papers.title: A Large-Scale Empirical Comparison of Meta-Learners and Causal Forests for Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation in Marketing Uplift Modeling
papers.abstract: Estimating Conditional Average Treatment Effects (CATE) at the individual level is central to precision marketing, yet systematic benchmarking of uplift modeling methods at industrial scale remains limited. We present UpliftBench, an empirical evaluation of four CATE estimators: S-Learner, T-Learner, X-Learner (all with LightGBM base learners), and Causal Forest (EconML), applied to the Criteo Uplift v2.1 dataset comprising 13.98 million customer records. The near-random treatment assignment (propensity AUC = 0.509) provides strong internal validity for causal estimation. Evaluated via Qini coefficient and cumulative gain curves, the S-Learner achieves the highest Qini score of 0.376, with the top 20% of customers ranked by predicted CATE capturing 77.7% of all incremental conversions, a 3.9x improvement over random targeting. SHAP analysis identifies f8 as the dominant heterogeneous treatment effect (HTE) driver among the 12 anonymized covariates. Causal Forest uncertainty quantification reveals that 1.9% of customers are confident persuadables (lower 95% CI > 0) and 0.1% are confident sleeping dogs (upper 95% CI < 0). Our results provide practitioners with evidence-based guidance on method selection for large-scale uplift modeling pipelines.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在个体层面上估计条件平均处理效应（Conditional Average Treatment Effects, CATE）是精准营销的核心内容，然而在工业规模上对提升模型（uplift modeling）方法进行系统性的基准测试仍然较为有限。我们提出了UpliftBench，这是一个针对四种CATE估计器的实证评估工具：S-Learner、T-Learner、X-Learner（均基于LightGBM作为基础学习器）以及Causal Forest（EconML），这些方法均应用于包含1398万条客户记录的Criteo Uplift v2.1数据集。近乎随机的处理分配方式（倾向性AUC = 0.509）为因果估计提供了强有力的内部有效性。通过Qini系数和累积收益曲线进行评估，S-Learner获得了最高的Qini分数0.376；按预测的CATE排名前20%的客户占据了所有增量转化的77.7%，这一效果比随机定位策略提升了3.9倍。SHAP分析表明，在12个匿名化的协变量中，f8是驱动异质性处理效应（Heterogeneous Treatment Effects, HTE）的主要因...。

papers.title: Sequential Audit Sampling with Statistical Guarantees
papers.abstract: Financial statement auditing is conducted under a risk-based evidence approach to obtain reasonable assurance. In practice, auditors often perform additional sampling or related procedures when an initial sample does not provide a sufficient basis for a conclusion. Across jurisdictions, current standards and practice manuals acknowledge such extensions, while the statistical design of sequential audit procedures has not been fully explored. This study formulates audit sampling with additional, sequentially collected items as a sequential testing problem for a finite population under sampling without replacement. We define null and alternative hypotheses in terms of a tolerable deviation rate, specify stopping and decision rules, and formulate exact sequential boundary conditions in terms of finite-population error probabilities. For practical implementation, we calibrate those boundaries by Monte Carlo simulation at least-favorable deviation rates. The exact design yields ex ante control of decision error probabilities, and the simulation-based implementation approximates that design while allowing the computation of expected stopping times. The framework is most naturally suited to attribute auditing and deviation-rate auditing, especially tests of controls, and it can be extended to one-sided, two-stage, and truncated designs.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】财务报表审计采用基于风险的证据收集方法来获取合理的保证。在实际操作中，当初始样本无法为审计结论提供充分依据时，审计师通常会进行额外的抽样或相关程序。在各个司法管辖区，现行标准和实践指南都认可这种扩展做法，但关于顺序审计程序的统计设计尚未得到充分研究。本研究将包含额外、顺序收集项目的审计抽样问题视为一个有限总体下的无放回抽样问题进行建模。我们根据可容忍偏差率来定义原假设和备择假设，明确停止规则和决策规则，并根据有限总体误差概率来制定精确的顺序边界条件。为了便于实际应用，我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟在至少有利的偏差率下对这些边界条件进行校准。这种精确的设计方法能够预先控制决策误差的概率，而基于模拟的实现方式可以在允许计算预期停止时间的同时，近似达到该设计目标。该框架特别适用于属性审计和偏差率审计（尤其是控制测试），并且可以扩展到单侧、两阶段和截断设计等情形。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: Can Personal Access to Medical Expertise Overcome Vaccine Hesitancy? -- by D. Mark Anderson, Ron Diris, Raymond Montizaan, Daniel I. Rees
papers.abstract: Using data on applicants to Dutch medical schools and their older relatives (i.e., parents, aunts, and uncles ages 60+), we estimate the effect of personal access to medical expertise on vaccine hesitancy.  Leveraging variation in lottery outcomes that determine admission to medical schools, we find that having a physician in the family increases the likelihood of complying with government recommendations that anyone over the age of 59 receive a second booster dose of a COVID-19 vaccine.  Our estimated effects are strongest for having a female physician in the family, suggesting important gender-based differences in how medical expertise is communicated.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们利用了申请荷兰医学院的学生及其年长亲属（即父母、阿姨和60岁以上的叔叔）的相关数据，来评估个人接触医学专业知识对疫苗接种意愿的影响。通过分析决定医学院录取结果的随机分配结果（即“抽签”结果），我们发现家庭中如果有医生，那么59岁以上人群遵循政府关于接种第二剂新冠疫苗的建议的可能性会增加。研究发现，这种影响在家庭中有女性医生的情况下最为显著，这表明在医学专业知识的传递过程中存在基于性别的差异。。

papers.title: Why Do Americans No Longer Work So Much More Than Non-Americans? -- by Serdar Birinci, Loukas Karabarbounis, Kurt See
papers.abstract: In the 1990s, Americans used to work much more than non-Americans. Nowadays, about half of the gap in hours worked has reversed. To evaluate the convergence of working hours, we develop a tractable  model of labor supply enriched with multiple sources of heterogeneity across individuals, an extensive margin of participation, multi-member households, and an elaborate system of taxes and benefits upon non-employment. Using detailed measurements from micro-level and aggregate datasets, we identify model parameters and sources of heterogeneity across individuals for various countries. We run a horse race between competing explanations and find that U.S. hours per person declined after 2000 owing mainly to the rise of government health benefits provided to the non-employed. Non-U.S. countries have generous benefits for the non-employed, but this generosity has not changed as much over time as in the United States, and public health coverage does not depend on employment status or income levels. For these countries, the rise of labor supply is generally accounted for by a mix of factors, such as the rise of wages and the falling disutility of work.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】20世纪90年代，美国人的工作时间明显长于非美国人。如今，两国在工作时长上的差距已有所缩小，大约一半的差距已经消失。为了评估工作时间的趋同趋势，我们构建了一个易于处理的劳动力供给模型，该模型充分考虑了个体间的多种异质性、广泛的参与度、多成员家庭结构，以及针对非就业者的复杂税收和福利制度。通过利用微观和宏观数据集的详细信息，我们确定了各国家庭的模型参数及个体间异质性的来源。通过对各种解释方案的比较分析，我们发现：自2000年以来，美国人均工作时间减少的主要原因是政府为非就业者提供了更多的健康福利。虽然非美国国家也为非就业者提供了较为优厚的福利，但这些福利的改善程度不如美国显著，且公共卫生保障并不依赖于就业状况或收入水平。在这些国家，劳动力供给的增加通常由多种因素共同作用所致，例如工资水平的上升以及工作负效用（即工作带来的不愉快感）的降低。。

papers.title: Lexicographic Robustness and the Efficiency of Optimal Mechanisms
papers.abstract: A central challenge in mechanism design is to identify mechanisms whose performance is robust under uncertainty about the environment. The maxmin optimality criterion is commonly used for this purpose, but it often yields a large and economically uninformative set of mechanisms. This paper proposes a lexicographic approach to refining the maxmin criterion and characterizes the efficiency of optimal mechanisms. In canonical screening and auction environments, the strongest refinement $\unicode{x2013}$ proper robustness $\unicode{x2013}$ selects ex post efficient mechanisms. By contrast, in a public good provision environment, it identifies the precise form of optimal inefficiencies, which become severe in large economies.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】机制设计中的一个核心挑战是识别那些在环境不确定性下仍能保持良好性能的机制。为此，人们通常使用最大最小最优性准则（maxmin optimality criterion），但该准则往往会导致生成一组规模庞大且在经济上缺乏信息量的机制。本文提出了一种基于词典排序（lexicographic approach）的方法来改进最大最小最优性准则，并对最优机制的效率进行了分析。在标准的筛选（canonical screening）和拍卖（auction）环境中，这种改进方法能够选出事后（ex post）具有高效性的机制；而在公共物品供给（public good provision）环境中，该方法能够准确识别出最优机制中的低效率问题，尤其是在经济规模较大的情况下，这些低效率问题会变得更加严重。。

papers.title: Inertial Mining: Equilibrium Implementation of the Bitcoin Protocol
papers.abstract: The value of proof-of-work cryptocurrencies critically depends on miners having incentives to follow the protocol. However, the Bitcoin mining protocol proposed by Nakamoto (2008) and implemented in practice is well known not to constitute an equilibrium: Eyal and Sirer (2018) construct a profitable deviation called ``selfish mining'' which relies on strategically delaying disclosure of newly mined blocks rather than publishing them immediately. We propose inertial mining, a novel mining protocol. When miners follow inertial mining, they produce the outcome intended by Nakamoto, i.e., a single longest chain. But unlike the Bitcoin mining protocol, inertial mining constitutes an equilibrium (assuming no miner controls more than half of the mining power). Indeed, neither selfish mining nor any other deviation is profitable. Furthermore, inertial mining only changes miners' behavior in the event of off-path forks, and can be implemented in Bitcoin without any changes to its consensus mechanism or blockchain architecture.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】工作量证明（Proof-of-Work, PoW）加密货币的价值在很大程度上取决于矿工是否有动力遵守相关协议。然而，中本聪（Nakamoto）于2008年提出的比特币挖矿协议在实际应用中并未达到真正的平衡状态：Eyal和Sirer（2018）指出了一种名为“自私挖矿”（selfish mining）的盈利性行为，这种行为通过策略性地延迟新挖掘区块的公开时间而非立即发布它们来实现。我们提出了一种名为“惯性挖矿”（inertial mining）的新挖矿协议。当矿工遵循惯性挖矿规则时，他们能够产生中本聪所期望的结果，即形成一条最长的区块链。与比特币挖矿协议不同，惯性挖矿确实能够实现平衡状态（前提是没有任何矿工控制超过一半的算力）。事实上，无论是自私挖矿还是其他任何偏离协议的行为都无法带来盈利。此外，惯性挖矿仅在区块链发生偏离（off-path forks）时才会改变矿工的行为，并且可以在不修改比特币的共识机制或区块链架构的情况下直接应用。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Beyond Black-Scholes: A Computational Framework for Option Pricing Using Heston, GARCH, and Jump Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: This research addresses accurate option pricing by employing models beyond the traditional Black-Scholes framework. While Black-Scholes provides a closed-form solution, it is limited by assumptions of constant volatility, no dividends, and continuous price movements. To overcome these limitations, we use Monte Carlo simulation alongside the GARCH model, Heston stochastic volatility model, and Merton jump-diffusion model. The Black-Scholes-Monte Carlo method simulates diverse stock price paths using geometric Brownian motion. The GARCH model forecasts time-varying volatility from historical data. The Heston model incorporates stochastic volatility to capture volatility clustering and skew. The Merton jump-diffusion model adds sudden price jumps via a Poisson process. Results show the Heston model consistently produces estimates closer to market prices, while the Merton model performs well for volatile assets with sudden price movements. The GARCH model provides improved volatility forecasts for future option price prediction. All experiments used live market data from November 2024.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究通过采用传统Black-Scholes框架之外的模型，致力于实现更精确的期权定价。尽管Black-Scholes模型能够提供封闭形式的解，但其局限性在于假设波动率恒定、无股息支付以及价格运动连续。为克服这些限制，我们结合使用了蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulation）、GARCH模型、Heston随机波动率模型（Heston stochastic volatility model）和Merton跳跃扩散模型（Merton jump-diffusion model）。Black-Scholes-Monte Carlo方法利用几何布朗运动（geometric Brownian motion）模拟多种股票价格路径；GARCH模型根据历史数据预测波动率的变化；Heston模型通过引入随机波动率来捕捉波动率的聚集性和偏度特征；Merton模型则通过泊松过程（Poisson process）模拟股票价格的突然跳跃。实验结果表明，Heston模型生成的期权价格估计值与市场价格的吻合度更高，而Merton模型在处理价格波动剧烈且具有突发性变动的资产时表现优异。此外，GAR...。研究方法：实验方法、蒙特卡洛模拟、GARCH 波动率模型、随机过程、数值模拟。

papers.title: Robust Testing Of the Allais Paradox By Paired Choices vs. Paired Valuations
papers.abstract: McGranaghan, Nielsen, O'Donoghue, Somerville, and Sprenger [2024] argue that standard paired choice tests for the common ratio effect are structurally biased when choice is stochastic, proposing valuation tests as a robust alternative. Using valuation tests, they find no systematic evidence for the common ratio effect, seemingly overturning much of the extant literature. We evaluate this conclusion in light of stochastic choice theory. We demonstrate that valuation tests are inherently biased and lack predictive power under standard expected utility assumptions. In contrast, we advocate for a ``strong'' paired choice test, proving it remains robustly unbiased across standard models of stochastic choice. Applying this strong test to existing experimental data, we find that the common ratio effect remains highly prevalent.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】McGranaghan、Nielsen、O’Donoghue、Somerville和Sprenger（2024）指出，当选择行为具有随机性时，用于检验“共同比率效应”（common ratio effect）的标准配对选择测试存在结构性偏差，因此他们提出使用估值测试（valuation tests）作为更为可靠的替代方法。通过估值测试，他们并未发现支持“共同比率效应”的系统性证据，这一结论似乎颠覆了现有的大量研究结果。我们从随机选择理论的角度对这一结论进行了评估。我们发现，在标准的期望效用假设下，估值测试本身存在偏差且缺乏预测能力。相比之下，我们提倡使用一种“强式”配对选择测试（strong paired choice test），并证明该测试在各种标准的随机选择模型中仍能保持无偏性。将这种强式测试应用于现有的实验数据后，我们发现“共同比率效应”实际上仍然普遍存在。。研究方法：实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: Direct Air Capture in Europe - Where to Integrate, Where to Store, and What Drives Cost?
papers.abstract: Direct Air Carbon Capture and Storage (DACCS) can mitigate hard-to-abate emissions, e.g. from transport or industry. However, there is a wide variety of cost estimates for DACCS, driven, to a significant extent, by differences in electricity cost. At the same time, there is a notable gap in research that integrates direct air capturing systems into long-term energy system models. We separate direct air capturing, carbon transport, and carbon storage and integrate them into a European capacity expansion model for a fully decarbonised electricity system in 2050. We explore how two dimensions affect the total system costs of DACCS. The first dimension is the availability of CO2 storage locations: In one analysis, storage locations are restricted to offshore storage locations in the North Sea only, i.e. depleted natural gas fields. The alternative analysis comprises suitable storage locations distributed across Europe, including onshore. We find that limiting CO2 storage to North Sea sites increases overall capture costs by approximately 10 %. The second dimension is whether DACCS is analysed as stand-alone or integrated into the electricity system. We differentiate between three alternatives: fully isolated, fully integrated, and retrospectively added to an existing system. We find that neglecting system integration - i.e. treating direct air capture system as a stand-alone technology - increases capture costs by up to 30 %.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】直接空气捕集与封存（DACCS）技术能够有效减少难以减排的温室气体排放，例如来自交通运输和工业领域的排放。然而，关于DACCS的成本估算存在较大差异，这些差异在很大程度上受到电力成本差异的影响。同时，在将直接空气捕集系统纳入长期能源系统模型的研究方面也存在明显不足。我们分别研究了直接空气捕集、碳运输和碳封存这三个环节，并将其整合到一个针对2050年完全实现脱碳的欧洲电力系统的容量扩展模型中。我们探讨了两个关键因素对DACCS总系统成本的影响：  

第一个因素是二氧化碳储存地点的可用性。在一种分析中，储存地点仅限于北海的海上设施（即已开采过的天然气田）；而在另一种分析中，则考虑了遍布欧洲的适宜储存地点，包括陆上设施。研究发现，将二氧化碳储存地点限制在北海地区会使总体捕集成本增加约10%。  

第二个因素是DACCS是作为独立技术进行评估，还是被整合到电力系统中。我们分析了三种情况：完全独立运行、完全整合到电力系统中，以及事后添加到现有系统中。结果表明，忽略系统整合（即将直接空气捕集技术视为独立技术）会使捕集成本增加高达30%。。
